# sherpa-onnx-sys

Raw Rust FFI bindings for [sherpa-onnx](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx),
version 1.13.4, licensed under Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).

This repository vendors the crate to authenticate its native library archives.
See [BUZZ-PATCH.md](BUZZ-PATCH.md) for provenance, supported targets, validation,
and the differences from upstream. Upstream usage examples are available in
the sherpa-onnx repository.
